start.title: Die Ebene Schinar
start.text:
Eine weite, grüne Ebene erstreckt sich vor dir.
Die ganze Menschheit hat sich hier versammelt – ein Volk, eine Sprache.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Settle and build a home
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] You sink roots into the earth. It feels right.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Dream of something greater
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Genesis 11:2 — The people settled in the plain of Shinar and dreamed of greatness.

unity.title: Eine Sprache
unity.text:
Stimmen verschmelzen. Gelächter steigt auf.
Es gibt kein Wort, das du nicht verstehst.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Praise God for the gift of unity
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] You lift your voice in thanks. Others bow their heads.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Boast of what we could achieve
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Genesis 11:4 — They said, 'Let us make a name for ourselves.'

choices.text: [TODO:de] Stay silent — listen to the elders
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Wise voices speak softly. Others shout louder.

proposal.title: Die große Idee
proposal.text:
Ein Ältester erhebt sich. „Lasst uns einen Turm bauen – seine Spitze soll bis in den Himmel reichen.“
„Lasst uns einen Namen machen für uns selbst.“

choices.text: [TODO:de] Cheer — join the great work
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Genesis 11:3-4 — The people joined together to build a city and a great tower.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Speak against it — this is pride
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Few hear you. But the words are spoken.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Wait — let others decide
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Silence is its own answer. The vote passes.

bricks.title: Ziegel und Teer
bricks.text:
Du formst nassen Ton zu Ziegeln.
Sie sind stärker als Stein. Sie werden den Himmel erreichen.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Work for the love of craft
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Genesis 11:3 — They made bricks and used tar for mortar to build the tower.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Race the others — outshine them
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Your speed turns to recklessness. Bricks crack.

construction.title: Die ersten Stockwerke
construction.text:
Mauern erheben sich. Der Turm wirft einen langen Schatten.
Männer singen, während sie jeden Balken heben.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Boast — "We need no God now"
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Genesis 11:4 — They boasted, seeking a tower with its top reaching the heavens.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Work quietly — say a prayer
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] No one hears. But the prayer is heard above.

rising.title: Höher
rising.text:
Jahr um Jahr. Stein auf Stein.
Der Turm durchstößt die Wolken.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Doubt — should we stop?
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] You whisper it. The wind carries the words away.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Climb higher — there is no limit
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Genesis 11:4-5 — The tower rose higher in pride until the Lord came down to see it.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Demand the workers go faster
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Tempers fray. Hands bleed. The tower climbs.

summit.title: Den Himmel berühren
summit.text:
Du stehst ganz oben. Die Erde ist klein unter dir.
Der Himmel fühlt sich nah an – fast zum Greifen nah.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Reach upward — claim the sky
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Genesis 11:4 — Their pride reached upward, seeking to make a name for themselves.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Kneel — feel suddenly small
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] The vastness above swallows your pride.

gods_gaze.title: Er kommt herab
gods_gaze.text:
Eine Stimme erfüllt die Luft, ruhig wie Donner.
„Sie sind ein Volk. Nichts wird ihnen unmöglich sein.“

choices.text: [TODO:de] Stand defiant before the voice
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Genesis 11:6-7 — God saw their pride and chose to confuse their language.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Bow your head in fear and awe
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Your knees buckle. The presence is everywhere.

confusion.title: Seltsame Worte
confusion.text:
Du rufst deinem Freund zu. Er starrt.
Sein Mund öffnet sich – doch die Laute ergeben keinen Sinn.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Force him to understand — shout louder
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Anger only deepens the void between you.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Step back — accept what God has done
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Genesis 11:7 — God confused their language so they could not understand one another.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Blame the elders — start a fight
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Fists fly. The tower bleeds men instead of mortar.

scattering.title: Auszug
scattering.text:
Familien sammeln, was sie können.
Jede Gruppe wandert einem anderen Horizont entgegen.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Curse the heavens as you leave
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Bitterness is a heavy load to carry.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Walk in silence, lesson in heart
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Genesis 11:8 — The Lord scattered the people from there over all the earth.

reflection.title: Ein neues Land
reflection.text:
Du hältst auf einem stillen Bergrücken an.
Der Turm liegt weit zurück – eine Erinnerung an Stolz.
